an4.122:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni udakorohantassa pāṭikaṃkhitabbāni.
an4.122:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārīmāni bhayāni idhekaccassa kulaputtassa imasmiṃ dhammavinaye saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito pāṭikaṃkhitabbāni
an4.122:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:2.3: otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an4.122:2.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an4.122:2.5: tamenaṃ tathāpabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti
an4.122:2.6: evante abhikkamitabbaṃ evante paṭikkamitabbaṃ evante āloketabbaṃ evante viloketabbaṃ evante sammiñjitabbaṃ evante pasāretabbaṃ evante saṃghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabbanti
an4.122:2.8: mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāmapi anusāsāmapi
an4.122:2.9: ime pana amhākaṃ puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantīti
an4.122:2.10: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an4.122:2.11: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto
an4.122:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:3.3: otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an4.122:3.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an4.122:3.5: tamenaṃ tathāpabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti
an4.122:3.6: idante khāditabbaṃ idante na khāditabbaṃ idante bhuñjitabbaṃ idante na bhuñjitabbaṃ idante sāyitabbaṃ idante na sāyitabbaṃ idante pātabbaṃ idante na pātabbaṃ kappiyante khāditabbaṃ akappiyante na khāditabbaṃ kappiyante bhuñjitabbaṃ akappiyante na bhuñjitabbaṃ kappiyante sāyitabbaṃ akappiyante na sāyitabbaṃ kappiyante pātabbaṃ akappiyante na pātabbaṃ kāle te khāditabbaṃ vikāle te na khāditabbaṃ kāle te bhuñjitabbaṃ vikāle te na bhuñjitabbaṃ kāle te sāyitabbaṃ vikāle te na sāyitabbaṃ kāle te pātabbaṃ vikāle te na pātabbanti
an4.122:3.8: mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā yaṃ icchāma taṃ khādāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ khādāma
an4.122:3.9: yaṃ icchāma taṃ bhuñjāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ bhuñjāma
an4.122:3.10: yaṃ icchāma taṃ sāyāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ sāyāma
an4.122:3.11: yaṃ icchāma taṃ pivāma yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ pivāma
an4.122:3.12: kappiyaṃpi khādāma akappiyaṃpi khādāma kappiyaṃpi bhuñjāma akappiyaṃpi bhuñjāma kappiyaṃpi sāyāma akappiyaṃpi sāyāma kappiyaṃpi pivāma akappiyaṃpi pivāma kālepi khādāma vikālepi khādāma kālepi bhuñjāma vikālepi bhuñjāma kālepi sāyāma vikālepi sāyāma kālepi pivāma vikālepi pivāma
an4.122:3.13: yaṃpi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti tatrāpīme mukhāvaraṇaṃ maññe karontīti
an4.122:3.14: so kupito anattamano sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an4.122:3.15: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu kumbhīlabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto
an4.122:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:4.3: otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an4.122:4.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an4.122:4.5: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pāvisi arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi
an4.122:4.6: so tattha passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ
an4.122:4.8: mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārayimhā
an4.122:4.9: saṃvijjante kho pana me kule bhogā
an4.122:4.10: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ
an4.122:4.11: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyanti
an4.122:4.13: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvaṭbhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto
an4.122:4.14: āvaṭbhayanti kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
an4.122:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an4.122:5.3: otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an4.122:5.4: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti
an4.122:5.5: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pāvisi arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi
an4.122:5.6: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā
an4.122:5.7: tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
an4.122:5.8: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an4.122:5.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu susukābhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto
an4.122:5.12: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri bhayāni idhekaccassa kulaputtassa imasmiṃ dhammavinaye saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito pāṭikaṃkhitabbānīti.
